title: Aug 4 · Wanting: __ ko __ chahiye
topic: Hindi doesn't say "I want water" — it says "To me, water is wanted"

pattern.name: Wanting things
notes: Names and nouns just add ko: Jacob ko, Michael ko.
Pronouns fuse with ko into a new word (see the table).
ye and vo can never combine with ko directly — they transform into is / us first.

vocab.note: always with a ko person: X ko Y chahiye · your pages: chahiay / chahiya
closest friends and little kids only
ye transforms into is before ko
vo transforms into us before ko

vocab.en: to them (near), or one respected person
vocab.note: respect = plural form, even for one person

vocab.en: to them (far), or one respected person

sentences.note: I = mujhko when fused with ko

sentences.en: We want mango and one lakh.
sentences.rom: Humko mango aur ek lakh chahiye.

sentences.note: names just add ko; nahi before the verb

sentences.en: She (partner, sitting next to you) wants a cake.

sentences.note: respect = plural form, even for one person

sentences.en: He (brother, far away) doesn't want a job.
They want samosa and pani puri. (near)
sentences.rom: Inko samosa aur pani puri chahiye.

sentences.en: They want samosa and pani puri. (far)
sentences.rom: Unko samosa aur pani puri chahiye.

sentences.en: They want this, they don't want that.
sentences.rom: Inko ye chahiye, vo nahi chahiye.
Inko ek hazaar paanch sau dollars chahiye.
sentences.note: big numbers read left to right
kaam = work is not confirmed in class yet — try it, then check with your teacher

watch_out: ye and vo never take ko — they become is / us first.
nahi sits just before chahiye: Jacob ko ball nahi chahiye.
is / us / in / un are pronounced "iss", "oos", "in", "oon".
ask_next_time: The word under "Michael ko" on the 8/4 page — couldn't be read (aam? gaana?). Whatever it is, it's the object Michael wants.
Two older worksheet lines used Inke / Unke before chahiye — they likely should be Inko / Unko. Double-check.
"She wants chocolates, not bananas" is on the worksheet without an answer — try it, then bring back the real one.
